blocks.text: AI Guard is a service that provides run-time protection for your AI applications by enforcing enterprise policies that prevent prompt injections, block jailbreak attempts, and stop personal information leakage with guardrails around LLM interactions.

This process involves a user sending a request that is first analyzed by AI Guard to see if it triggers any detectors. If the prompt isn't blocked, the LLM provider then processes the prompt and returns a response to AI Guard for analysis. If the response isn't blocked, it is then sent to the user. Depending on the complexity of the prompt, speed of analysis, and internet speed, this can cause latency in the AI application interaction for the user. AI Guard tracks this information and includes it in the details of every logged transaction.

blocks.item: Go to AI Security Admin Portal > AI Guard > Dashboard. The Dashboard page opens.
Find the transaction you want to see the latency information for and in its Details column, click the View Details button. The Transaction Details window appears.
In the Performance & Network Stats section, you will find the following latency-related information about the transaction:
Total Time Taken By LLM: Time it took for the LLM provider to read the prompt and return a response.
Detection Time on Request: Time it took for the AI Guard policy detectors to analyze the prompt.
Detection Time On Response: Time it took for the AI Guard policy detectors to analyze the response.
